investorLoan.title: Loan request
investorLoan.accountsNote: My loan account balance in each company's books today. Admin records loans; this page only sends requests.
investorLoan.amountFormat: Enter the amount in rupees, e.g. 100000.
investorLoan.rule: Loans to directors have Companies Act limits, so Admin checks with the CA first. Money lent to a company needs your declaration that it isn't borrowed.
